text: Deploy Siege Mode 架设攻城模式
Deploy into an immobile siege howitzer: extreme range and high-explosive shells, but the cannon cannot move while deployed. 架设为固定攻城炮：超远射程、高爆炮弹，但架设期间无法移动。
Limber the gun and return to a mobile assault gun with armour-piercing shot. 收炮并返回机动突击炮，恢复穿甲直射。
Skullcannon (Deployed) 颅骨魔炮（攻城架设）
A Skullcannon dug in as a fixed siege howitzer, hurling screaming skulls in high arcs over field and wall alike. Its bound flesh strains while deployed. 架设为固定攻城炮的颅骨魔炮，以高抛弹道把尖啸颅骨砸向战场与城墙，束缚其中的血肉躁动难安。
